# SB Autoworks

> Mobile car detailing in South Jersey. We come to the customer's driveway or workplace, fully self-contained with our own water and power. Services include interior and exterior detailing, paint correction, and Ceramic Pro coatings. Licensed and insured (SBR Ventures LLC), 3+ years of professional experience, 5.0 rating on Google from 13 reviews.

- Phone / text: (856) 538-0407
- Instagram and Facebook: @SB_AutoworksNJ
- Website: https://sbautoworks.com
- Booking: through the website form, by call or text, or by Instagram/Facebook DM. We usually reply within a few minutes.
- Service area: Cumberland County and surrounding South Jersey, within about an hour of Vineland. Includes Vineland, Bridgeton, Millville, Glassboro, Woodbury, Hammonton, Pittsgrove, Pennsville, Deptford, Elmer, Atlantic City, and Ocean City.
- Payment: cash, credit/debit card, Zelle, Venmo, Cash App, PayPal.
- Vehicles: sedans, SUVs, minivans, pickup trucks, work trucks, and fleets.

## Packages and pricing

- Refresh Detail ($105–$145): exterior hand wash, wheels and tires, tire shine, exterior glass, interior vacuum, dash and console wipe-down, door jambs.
- Signature Detail ($165–$195, most popular): everything in Refresh plus trim conditioner, seat and mat shampoo, leather cleaning and conditioning, spray wax and paint sealant.
- Elite Detail ($265–$295): everything in Signature plus carpet and headliner steam clean and shampoo, clay bar, iron decontamination, cabin odor treatment.
- Paint Correction (from $320): 1-step or 2-step machine polishing to remove swirl marks, light scratches, water spots, and oxidation.
- Ceramic Pro Coating (from $1,150): long-term ceramic paint protection.
- Disaster Detail (custom quote): heavily soiled vehicles, pet hair, severe stains, and odors. Send photos for a quote.
- Add-ons (from $25): pet hair removal, headlight restoration, odor elimination, tar and sap removal, water spot treatment, engine bay detail, ceramic spray coating, seat wash and shampoo.
- Maintenance plans: recurring details at up to 40% off, with priority scheduling and no contracts. The first detail is at regular price.
- Discounts: fleet clients, multiple vehicles in one appointment, and customers who supply their own water.
